name: brand-tracker-wave-refresh
description: Next-quarter tracker update: import Wave 5, run the dataset-replacement review on saved slide recipes, and apply the wave_refresh template mode so recomputed titles are flagged for human confirmation and flat movers are demoted. The authoritative refresh runs against the real VelocityEngine; this contract records that reference plus a browser smoke that the Wave 5 file loads and analyses.

engineReference.notes: Builds the Wave 4 deck, imports Wave 5, runs assessDatasetReplacement on the saved slide recipes (all resolvable -> ready), recomputes each action title's direction/magnitude against Wave 5 (flagged for confirmation, never silently rewritten per 08 4), and flags the previously significant unaided-awareness mover as a demotion candidate now that it is flat W4->W5. Uses TemplateRefreshMode 'wave_refresh'.

preconditions: Dev server reachable via Playwright baseURL (default: http://127.0.0.1:4173).
Engine refresh artifact reproducible via `npm run demo:brand-tracker-wave-refresh` (exit 0).

steps.goal: Attach the Wave 5 refresh file (the next-quarter update)
Confirm the Wave 5 refresh wave loads with the same schema as Wave 4 (ready for dataset replacement)
